newsitem.title: USA: Texas Indus Q3 likely down from weather.
newsitem.headline: Texas Indus Q3 likely down from weather.

text.p: Texas Industries Inc said on Wednesday that unusually poor weather conditions over the last six weeks had increased shipments in its third quarter ending in February, which will most likely produce lower earnings versus the previous third quarter.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for the company's third quarter is $1.57 a share, compared to $1.41 third quarter last year.
The company said that it is confident about the company's future and earnings potential.
Texas Industries declared a two-for-one stock split and increased its regular quarterly dividend 50 percent ot $0.075 per share.
The company's next dividend is payable February 28, 1997, the same date that the stock split is effective, to holders of record February 3.
